english.note: This is the all-purpose adverb for doing something slowly.
This is the all-purpose choice for doing something at a slow pace.

examples.english: Take it slow; there’s no need to rush.
examples.jyutping: nei5 maan6 maan6 sik6 m4 sai2 gap1

examples.english: Walk slowly; there's no need to hurry.
examples.jyutping: nei5 maan6 maan6 haang4 m4 sai2 gap1

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something changing or progressing gradually.

examples.english: The weather is gradually getting colder again.
examples.jyutping: tin1 hei3 maan6 maan6 dung3 faan1 laa3
